title: console(metadata-admin): the External Datasource panel reads the raw {success,data} envelope — remote tables list empty, no catalog timestamp, and Validation crashes with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"
body:
QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#21784 · integration-system.external-schema-browser-ui · acceptance[1]
Also: also acceptance[3], acceptance[4], negative[0], negative[4]

A clause of `integration-system.external-schema-browser-ui` fails in the ObjectStack 17.7 pre-release checklist run objectstack-ai/objectstack#21784 (framework subject `316be321e`, console pin `2e818d0b51ec`). An independent verifier (VF3, RUNNER rule 7) confirmed it: P2. It predates the 17.6.0 console pin `31971ff1e`; no open duplicate was found. Owner: objectui.

## Reproduction

1. Stock showcase boot (it ships datasource `showcase_external`), admin form sign-in.
2. Open `/_console/apps/setup/metadata/datasource/showcase_external` (also under `/apps/studio/metadata/datasource/…`).
3. Network: `GET …/external/tables` → `{"success":true,"data":{"tables":[{"name":"customers","columnCount":7},{"name":"orders","columnCount":7}]}}`. Panel: "No remote tables found (check the datasource's allowedSchemas)." Expected two rows.
4. "Refresh catalog" → 200 with `data.catalog.snapshotAt`. Expected a timestamp; none renders.
5. Validation tab → "Run validation" → 200 `{success,data:{ok:true,results:[2 rows]}}`. Panel replaced by "Preview failed to render — Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')". Expected verdict rows.
6. The import dialog (A3) reads `data.draft` through the same code and is unreachable while the list is empty. Seen twice by the runner and twice by the verifier.

## Mechanism

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/external/api.ts:133` `jsonOrThrow` returns the raw body; callers read `data.tables` (`:146-147`), `data.draft` (`:164-165`), `data.catalog` (`:174-175`), and validate returns the body as `{ok,results}` (`:186`).
- Every framework route answers through `sendOk` `{success:true,data:{…}}` (`packages/rest/src/external-datasource-routes.ts:420` etc.).
- Consumers: `SchemaBrowser.tsx:53`, `ExternalDatasourcePanel.tsx:72/119`, `ValidationPanel.tsx:135-159` (`results.length` on undefined).
- objectui's `api.test.ts` mocks the bare `{tables}` shape, so the unit test hides it. `api.ts` last changed at `31971ff1e`; the server envelope is present at `617f25f8a`. No duplicate found.

## Done when

The client unwraps the envelope for tables / draft / catalog / validate, the test fixture uses the real wire shape, and the panel lists, refreshes and validates.

**Related:** the server-side import twin defect is `objectstack-ai/objectstack#21788` (separate card).
